events.verdict: Grimes (PHI) briefly has an arm wrapped around Simons (BOS) before removing it.
Grimes (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position defending Brown (BOS) in the post and during his shot attempt.
Barlow (PHI) retracts his hands as he places them against White (BOS) before releasing away.
Queta (BOS) moves laterally into Maxey (PHI), affecting his driving shot attempt.
Although Brown (BOS) re-adjusts his screening position, the ensuing contact with Grimes (PHI) is marginal.
Grimes (PHI) avoids making contact with Brown's (BOS) arm during his jump shot attempt.
Hauser (BOS) grabs Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) arm as he sets the screen.
Tillman (BOS) extends an arm into Grimes (PHI) as he jumps toward him and the illegal contact affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Brown (BOS) re-adjusts his screening position and the contact with Maxey (PHI) as he moves around the screen is marginal.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) avoids intentionally kicking the ball.
Grimes (PHI) reaches in and makes contact to the ball, causing Brown (BOS) to briefly lose control.
Brown (BOS) briefly places an arm against Grimes' (PHI) side as he makes a move to the basket.
Barlow (PHI) legally contests Brown's (BOS) shot attempt near the rim.
Both Pritchard (BOS) and Edgecombe (PHI) get their hands on the ball and any contact between the two players during the loose ball is incidental.
Pritchard (BOS) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Barlow (PHI) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) and Brown (BOS) briefly engage during the throw-in and although both players fall to the floor, there is no illegal contact between them.
Simons (BOS) commits a take foul on Edgecombe (PHI).
Edgecombe (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position during Pritchard's (BOS) drive to the basket.
Hauser (BOS) and Maxey (PHI) briefly engage during the throw-in and Maxey loses his balance on his own accord.
Minott (BOS) commits a take foul on Edgecombe (PHI).
Grimes (PHI) legally contests Pritchard's (BOS) driving shot attempt.
The ball is last touched by Oubre Jr. (PHI) before going out of bounds.
Edgecombe (PHI) jumps and lands, obtaining a legal guarding position to the side of Pritchard (BOS). The ensuing marginal contact is initiated by Pritchard during his shot attempt.
